button.label: Create Guide
button.supertip: Captures the previous slide as a semi-transparent overlay on the current slide so you can line up animation.

button.label: Clear Guide
button.supertip: Deletes the onion-skin guide on the current slide only.

button.label: Clear All Guides
button.supertip: Deletes every onion-skin guide shape from this presentation.

menu.label: Animation Mode
menu.supertip: Choose what happens automatically when a new slide is created. The active mode is shown with a check mark.

toggleButton.label: Classic
toggleButton.supertip: Each new slide receives a semi-transparent guide from the previous slide.

toggleButton.label: Duplicate
toggleButton.supertip: Each new slide is filled with a copy of the previous slide and also receives an onion-skin guide underneath.

button.label: Export
button.supertip: Exports an animated GIF. Open the menu for Image, GIF, or Video. Onion-skin guides are left out.

menu.label: Image
menu.supertip: Writes one image per slide. Choose PNG or SVG.

button.label: PNG
button.supertip: Saves each slide as a PNG in the output folder.

button.label: SVG
button.supertip: Saves each slide as an SVG in the output folder.

button.label: GIF
button.supertip: Renders an animated GIF. Onion-skin guides are left out.

button.label: Video
button.supertip: Renders an MP4 (1080p, 30fps). Onion-skin guides are left out.

toggleButton.label: All slides
toggleButton.supertip: Image, GIF, and Video include the whole presentation. This choice is remembered.

toggleButton.label: Selected slides
toggleButton.supertip: Image, GIF, and Video include the slides selected in the thumbnail pane. If none are selected, only the current slide is exported. This choice is remembered.

button.label: Set output folder...
button.supertip: Pick the folder where exports are saved. Defaults to the same folder as the active presentation (or Desktop if it has not been saved).
